Banks, insurance companies, and other financial service firms pose unique challenges for an analyst attempting to value them for two reasons.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Framing industry- and sector-level factor models as a distinct class from academic Fama-French factors: sector membership is a categorical cross-sectional exposure, sector-specific multiples (subscribers, reserves, ARR, FFO) reveal industry-specific cash-flow drivers, and Damodaran's financial-service-firms exemplar shows how regulatory structure makes generic valuation machinery break down.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Industry and Sector Factor Models
